#schema: # /coordinate is prose with no shirabe or koto call line. The coordinator
# runs gh and git itself through the commands its references show, so both
# are declared tool-only and checked for presence.
# The record's codec (record-render.sh, record-parse.sh) and every script
# that reads or writes the record are jq programs over the rendered tables.
# posture-read.sh) read GitHub with gh, decode the roadmap file with base64
# (coreutils, undeclared), and store each check's detail as data with
# `koto context add --from-file`; record-confirm.sh finds the session's log
# through `koto session dir`, as coord-log.sh does.
